title: Israeli Strike Kills One in Wata al-Khiam
detail: Lebanon's health ministry said an Israeli strike on a home in south Lebanon's Wata al-Khiam killed one person. The IDF confirmed the strike, saying it targeted a member of Hezbollah's anti-tank missile unit. The strike came amid lingering tensions despite the ceasefire framework, which Israel says allows it to act against imminent threats in Lebanon.

media.caption: Aftermath of Israeli strike on a home in Wata al-Khiam, south Lebanon
